title: RFP Volume I (Instructions to Bidders)

voice.rule: The Agency's voice in the third person (the Agency shall …); the firm does not speak in the RFP.

defined_terms.rule: The glossary is a two-column table (Term | Meaning) with the term in bold and no quotation marks; in the body (the X) bold.
defined_terms.pointer_formula: Capitalised terms used but not otherwise defined herein shall have the meaning ascribed thereto in Volume I (Tender Procedure) of the RFP.

headings.rule: Title Case (the master's ALL CAPS headings are kept where the master has them; new headings are Title Case).

law.text: The procurement law is [applicable procurement law]; the PPP law is [applicable PPP law]; the procuring department is [●].

notes: The master's [CONFIRM - …] and [DRAFT - …] markers are the skill's flags for the lawyer, not placeholders to fill.
The master names a province's PPP Act, procurement rules and regulator; drafts write [applicable PPP law], [applicable procurement rules] and [●] instead.

banned.reason: Figures in brackets are not zero-padded: five (5) days, not five (05) days.
